name: setValuesBackground
description: When determining a member's values, it can be helpful to understand their background and context. This function allows you to set the background information of a member, which can include their upbringing, education, cultural influences, religion, philosophy and any other relevant factors.

cultural.description: Cultural influences and background of the member, described in natural language; can be `null`

education.description: Educational background of the member, described in natural language; can be `null`

philosophical.description: Philosophical education and predilections of the member, described in natural language; can be `null`

religious.description: Religious education and affiliations of the member, described in natural language; can be `null`

upbringing.description: Upbringing and family background of the member, described in natural language; can be `null`

other.description: Any other relevant background information of the member, described in natural language; optional
